title: Step 3 · Holds & release · held to released · 17.2 s
sub: Lot 118-B on one record: held from NC-204's containment, the disposition and rework land, the owner enters the re-inspection, signs the release under Part 11, and the lot can only be released once the signature is on the record.

beats.head: Held (the poster)
beats.text: HLD-118, lot 118-B, placed from NC-204's containment. On hold, 0 of 6, Release lot locked.

beats.head: The quarantine
beats.text: M. Osei, 08:06: lot 118-B quarantined, 240 units tagged and moved to the hold area.

beats.head: Reason and scope tick themselves
beats.text: NC-204, coating 38.1 µm against spec 45 to 55; lot 118-B, 240 units, line 2. 2 of 6.

beats.head: The disposition arrives
beats.text: Mon, Sep 28: J. Rivera posts NC-204's disposition, rework to spec, re-inspect 3 samples. It ticks in from NC-204. 3 of 6.

beats.head: Reworked
beats.text: M. Kerr: rework done on line 2, all 240 units recoated. Rework order ticks live, WO-8901 done. 4 of 6.

beats.head: Entered
beats.text: The results typed, the pointer back to tick the row.

beats.head: Ticked and saved
beats.text: The value sits on the record at 14:08. 5 of 6.

beats.head: Sign, on the checklist
beats.text: She presses Sign on Release signature.

beats.head: The Part 11 dialog
beats.text: Meaning of signature: Approval, I approve release of this lot.

beats.head: Her credentials
beats.text: User ID mosei, password typed. Name, meaning and time kept on the record.

beats.head: Sealed on both sides
beats.text: Signed on Release signature (Approval · 14:12) and her signature card in the thread. 6 of 6.

beats.head: Release unlocks
beats.text: Only with the signature on the record does Release lot unlock.

beats.head: Released
beats.text: Status Released. The thread records lot 118-B released by M. Osei, 240 units cleared for use.

beats.head: End at rest
beats.text: The released lot. The page holds this 1.5 s, then the next tab starts.
